(actor child_storage_writer
 (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input start) (output done) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var status (width 8) (reset 19)) (var unrelated (width 7) (reset 3)))
 (transaction worker (set status 37) (complete done))
 (transaction parent (on start)
  (spawn worker as w0) (await_all done) (update observed status) (complete done)))

claim_legs.durability: Exact accepted sources, generated artifacts, testbench/runner bytes, runtime output, decision 0107 and scheduled repair leaves.
claim_legs.falsify: Independent runtime oracles require parent-to-child 53 and child-to-parent 37; actual external 73 and retained reset 19 violate those requirements.
claim_legs.rederive: Strict native checks, standalone worker semantic input inventory and complete materialized artifacts.

assignment_records.rendered: assign worker_idle_0_next_state_worker_set_0_en = worker_idle_0_en & start;  // next_state <- WORKER_SET_0

auxiliary_assignments: assign worker_idle_0_next_state_worker_set_0_en = worker_idle_0_en & start;  // next_state <- WORKER_SET_0

mechanisms: LoweringIR::_build_child_ir copies actor declared_storage and resets into each generated child; writes produce independent registers without parent storage links.

Read-only child status is inferred INPUT; CompositionTop emits no storage handoff. PlanBuilder calls TopPortInferenceBuilder::augment_undeclared_top_inputs, adding a public status input and binding it to the worker.
SourceFrontend creates a fresh SignalManager for every semantic module; a hypothesized cross-root attribute leak is not the cause.
next: Implement live read handoffs under .39.2.2.2; then qualify full-width sole-writer handoffs and wider writer ownership/arbitration under .39.2.2.3/.4.
normalization: Repository absolute prefixes in reports are replaced with repository-relative paths; source/FSM/HDL/testbench/runner text is unchanged and sha256 binds original bytes.
scope: Generated transaction children within one actor; no external repository or submodule access.
